jobs.description:
You will join an international consulting firm based in the center of Brussels. The office is easily accessible by public transports.

Jobomschrijving

As an Office Assistant your responsibilities are:

• Welcome visitors professionally and direct them to the right contact or meeting area.
• Manage incoming calls and route messages accurately to support clear communication.
• Handle incoming and outgoing post, parcels and deliveries in an organised way.
• Keep the reception area tidy, presentable and ready for daily visitors.
• Coordinate meeting room bookings and help ensure rooms are prepared for use.
• Provide day-to-day administrative support.
• Order office supplies. 
• Respond to general enquiries and provide practical information to visitors and colleagues.

• You are perfectly bilingual in French and English, Dutch is a plus. 
• You have a first experience in receptionist, office management or administration. 
• Ability to manage a reception desk and greet visitors in a professional manner.
• Good organisational skills and proactive.
• Excellent communication skills.
• Good skills in MS Office.

Our client is a well-established Belgian consulting company with more than 15 years of success and a strong reputation in technology consulting. Over the last few years, the company has made a strategic shift towards one of the fastest-growing markets: Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Machine Learning and AI Leadership.Today, their challenge isn't finding talent.It's finding enough clients for the exceptional consultants already in the business.That's where you come in.

Jobomschrijving

You will be responsible for developing new business opportunities and growing a portfolio of clients across Brussels and Belgium.From first contact to long-term partnership, you'll own the entire sales cycle.You will:

• Identify and approach new clients
• Build relationships with decision-makers and executives
• Understand business challenges and propose the right consulting solution
• Sell AI expertise
• Negotiate commercial agreements and close deals
• Work closely with recruiters to match the right consultants to client needs
• Follow consultants on-site and ensure long-term client satisfaction
• Continuously expand your network and market knowledge

• You know how staffing and consulting work.
• You've already sold projects, consultants, services or expertise.
• You enjoy hunting for opportunities and building lasting commercial relationships.
• Youprobably have:
• 2 to 6 years of experience in consulting, staffing, recruitment or IT services
• Experience developing new accounts from scratch
• A strong commercial mindset and entrepreneurial spirit
• The ability to challenge, influence and convince stakeholders
• Fluency in English, French and/or Dutch
• A passion for business development and people
• Mostimportantly:
• You don't wait for leads.
• You create them.

Our client is a growing international company with a strong presence across Europe. Known for its customer-focused approach and innovative solutions, the company supports businesses in improving their operational performance and continues to invest in ambitious commercial talent.

Jobomschrijving

As a Sales Representative (FR/NL) - International Company, your responsibilities will include:

• Actively identify and approach prospective clients across Belgium to generate new business opportunities.
• Schedule and conduct client meetings to understand business needs and present tailored solutions.
• Build and manage a strong sales pipeline through prospecting, networking and lead follow-up activities.
• Negotiate commercial agreements and manage opportunities from initial contact through to successful closure.
• Maintain accurate records in the CRM system and contribute to the achievement of individual and team sales targets.

A successful Sales Representative (Fr/Nl) - International Company should have:

• Fluency in French and Dutch, with a professional command of English.
• A Bachelor's degree or equivalent through experience.
• Up to 3 years of experience in sales, customer service, business development or a client-facing role.
• Strong communication, negotiation and relationship-building skills.
• A proactive, commercial mindset with the motivation to achieve and exceed targets.

At Bel Group, they believe that healthier food is the future. As a leading international family-owned food company, Bel is behind some of the world's most loved brands, including Babybel, Kiri, Boursin and Maredsous.What makes Bel different from many traditional FMCG companies is their long-term vision, strong entrepreneurial culture and genuine commitment to sustainability. Their mission is simple: provide healthier and more responsible food for all. As a family-owned business, they focus on sustainable growth rather than short-term financial pressure, creating an environment where people can develop, contribute and build lasting careers.To further strengthen our Belgian Retail team, they are looking for a Key Account Manager to manage some of their most strategic retail partnerships.

Jobomschrijving

As a Key Account Manager Retail at Bel your responsibilities are:

• Develop and implement customer business plans aligned with Bel's commercial strategy.
• Manage strategic retail accounts
• Drive profitable sales growth, market share and category performance.
• Lead annual negotiations and customer agreement discussions.
• Identify growth opportunities and proactively develop new business initiatives.
• Build strong customer partnerships and long-term collaboration plans.
• Coordinate closely with cross-functional teams including Marketing, Category Management, Supply Chain, Finance, Revenue Growth Management and Sales Operations.
• Monitor performance, analyse customer data and recommend corrective actions when needed.
• Ensure excellent execution of promotional and commercial plans.

• 3 to 5 years of relevant experience in FMCG, Retail or OTC environments.
• Experience in Account Management, Customer Development, Category Management, Trade Marketing or Key Account Management.
• Exposure to negotiations with retail customers is highly desirable.
• Experience within a large international organisation is ideal.
• Strong commercial mindset with excellent analytical abilities.
• Fluent Dutch or French with a good knowledge of English.

Our client is a well-established global technology and manufacturing organization with over a century of industry expertise. The company develops innovative commercial equipment and intelligent embedded control systems used by businesses and institutions worldwide.

Jobomschrijving

• Design, develop, and maintain embedded firmware using C programming for electronic control systems.
• Develop reliable and efficient software solutions for next-generation embedded products.
• Create and execute test plans and validation activities to ensure product quality and performance.
• Collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams to validate firmware on prototypes and production units.
• Perform root cause analysis, troubleshooting, and debugging of firmware and hardware integration issues.
• Optimize communication and interaction between embedded systems, peripherals, and control components.
• Work extensively with embedded interfaces and peripherals, including UART, I2C, ADC, PWM, EEPROM, timers, and interrupts.
• Support new product development initiatives, feature enhancements, and product releases.
• Manage firmware revisions, documentation, and engineering change activities.
• Utilize source control and issue-management tools to support structured development practices.
• Provide technical support to manufacturing teams during pilot builds and production deployments.
To apply online please click the 'Apply' button below. For a confidential discussion about this role please contact Gift Petto on  66 2 012 5067.

• Bachelor's Degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related discipline.
• Minimum 7 years of experience in embedded firmware development.
• Strong proficiency in C programming for embedded systems.
• Hands-on experience working with microcontrollers and embedded communication protocols.
• Solid understanding of UART, I2C, ADC, PWM, EEPROM, interrupt handling, and timer-based applications.
• Proven experience in debugging, troubleshooting, and performance optimization of embedded applications.
• Familiarity with version control systems such as Git.
• Experience working with issue-tracking and software development lifecycle tools.
• Knowledge of test-driven development or structured software testing methodologies is an advantage.
• Ability to work effectively with international engineering teams and stakeholders.
• Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving capability, and attention to detail.
• Good communication skills with the ability to work in English-speaking environments.

Our client is an international retail organization renowned for its people-centric Nordic culture, strong focus on employee well-being and commitment to internal development.As part of its continued growth, the company is looking for a HR Business Partner to support retail operations across Wallonia.This opportunity is ideal for an ambitious HR professional looking to take a first step into HR Business Partnering within a dynamic, multi-site environment, while benefiting from extensive exposure to operational HR topics, coaching and career development opportunities.

Jobomschrijving

As Hr Business Partner, your responsibilities are:

• Partner with regional and store management teams to drive people performance and business objectives.
• Regularly visit retail locations to support managers and employees in the field.
• Lead talent management, succession planning, recruitment and employee development initiatives.
• Coach managers on performance management, employee relations, and disciplinary matters.
• Drive employee engagement, retention, and employer branding initiatives.
• Ensure compliance with labour legislation, company policies, and HR best practices.
• Monitor HR KPIs such as turnover, absenteeism, internal mobility, and employee satisfaction.
• Support health, safety, wellbeing, and workplace culture initiatives across the region.

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology or a related field.
• Around 3 to 5 years of experience in Human Resources, Talent Acquisition or a generalist HR role, with a strong ambition to grow into an HR Business Partner position.
• Good understanding of core HR processes and willingness to further develop expertise in employment law and employee relations.
• Exposure to recruitment, talent management, onboarding, learning & development or other people-related HR activities.
• Eager to learn, able to build relationships with managers and gradually develop advisory capabilities within an operational environment.
• Comfortable working autonomously and spending time in operational locations across multiple sites.
• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to challenge and support managers when needed.
• Fluency in French and English required (both oral and written). Knowledge of Dutch is considered a strong asset.

We are looking for loaders - unloaders for a leading logistics company specializing in the efficient transportation of goods.This is an on-call position, where you will be deployed as needed, providing flexibility in your schedule.This means we can also be flexible for you (for example, if there are certain days you cannot work, we can keep this in mind).You'll work in a 2 shift system.One week you'll work from 5h (morning) until 13h (afternoon)The other week you'll work from 13h (afternoon) until 21h (evening)
- Vaardigheden:You are flexibleYou are able to do physical work You can work well in a teamYou have your own transportation to get to work on these hours (bike, car, step,..)- Attesten:/- Opleidingsvereisten:/- Vakkennis:/- Talenkennis:English

Our client is a renowned international law firm with offices in Brussels.

Jobomschrijving

• Managing complex calendars, scheduling meetings, and coordinating appointments.
• Assisting with client onboarding and administrative file management.
• Supporting billing, expense processing, and timesheet administration.
• Organising travel arrangements and other logistical requirements.
• Drafting, formatting, editing, and finalising legal and business documents.
• Maintaining structured filing and document management systems.
• Acting as a first point of contact for clients and visitors, handling calls and correspondence professionally.
• Coordinating meeting rooms and visitor arrangements.
• Liaising with internal support teams to ensure efficient service delivery.
• Providing general administrative support.

• You have a minimum five years of experience in a Legal Secretary, Executive Assistant, or similar support role.
• You have strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities effectively.
• You have excellent communication skills in English, with a good command of French and/or Dutch.
• You are proficient in using Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook and PowerPoint).
• You are able to work independently while collaborating effectively within a team.
• You have strong attention to detail and commitment to delivering high-quality work.
• You are known for being professional and discreet.

Our client operates a network of physical stores and digital channels across Belgium and the Netherlands. To support ongoing business transformation and operational excellence initiatives, the company is looking for a Business Process Analyst to join a dynamic team focused on process optimization, user support, and continuous improvement.

Jobomschrijving

As a Business Process Analyst, you will act as a key link between operational teams and technology stakeholders. You will help analyze, document, improve, and support business processes across store operations, digital activities, and back-office functions. This position combines business analysis, process improvement, stakeholder management, and operational support, making it ideal for someone who enjoys understanding how a business works and driving tangible improvements.Key Responsibilities

• Analyze and document end-to-end business processes across retail and digital operations.
• Gather, challenge, and translate business requirements into actionable solutions.
• Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, service quality, and user experience.
• Support business users by investigating operational issues and coordinating solutions with internal teams.
• Participate in projects related to process optimization, digital transformation, and operational excellence.
• Organize workshops with stakeholders to understand needs and define future processes.
• Develop process maps, business documentation, and functional requirements.
• Promote a culture of continuous improvement and help monitor the effectiveness of implemented solutions.
• Work closely with cross-functional teams in Belgium and the Netherlands.

• Experience as a Business Analyst, Process Analyst, Functional Analyst, or in a similar position.
• Previous exposure to retail, omnichannel, customer service, supply chain, or operational environments is an asset.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Able to understand business needs and translate them into practical solutions.
• Comfortable interacting with stakeholders at different levels of the organization.
• Experience with process mapping and continuous improvement methodologies.
• Familiarity with tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, Visio, SAP, Salesforce, or similar is considered a plus.
• Dutch: mandatory ; English: excellent professional level

jobs.occupation: Compliance Officer - Brussels - Venture Capital Firm
jobs.description:
Our client is an established investment management organisation based in Brussels, operating in an international and highly regulated environment. The offices are easily accessible and offer the opportunity to work closely with senior stakeholders on strategic compliance matters.

Jobomschrijving

• Contribute to the development and enhancement of the compliance and risk framework
• Monitor regulatory developments and support the implementation of new regulatory requirements
• Oversee AML/CFT activities and participate in related control and reporting processes
• Support interactions with regulators, supervisory authorities and regulatory filings
• Assess and monitor outsourced service providers and ICT-related risks
• Provide compliance support across fund operations, including investment monitoring and conflict assessments
• Participate in regulatory analyses supporting new jurisdictions, fundraising activities and cross-border operations

• Master's degree in Law, Finance or a related field
• Minimum 2 years of experience in a similar Compliance position
• Experience within an AIFM, investment fund, private equity, venture capital, asset management or another regulated financial services organisation
• Fluent in English; French and/or Dutch are valuable assets
• Strong knowledge of financial regulations, compliance controls and risk management practices
• Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret and apply evolving regulatory requirements
• Excellent communication skills and ability to interact with multiple internal and external stakeholders

Our client is an international organisation operating within a highly regulated and innovative industry. From its European hub in Brussels, the company supports customers across multiple European markets, delivering high-quality solutions and services while maintaining a strong focus on customer satisfaction, collaboration, and operational excellence.

Jobomschrijving

Invoicing & Financial Administration

• Prepare, verify, and process invoices for customer service activities across European markets.
• Review work orders, service reports, and supporting documentation prior to invoicing.
• Follow up on missing, incomplete, or inaccurate information.
• Collaborate closely with Finance to ensure accurate and timely billing.
Administrative Support

• Maintain and update administrative records and documentation.
• Ensure data accuracy within ERP and CRM systems.
• Provide administrative support to Customer Experience and Customer Care teams.
• Prepare, monitor, and manage a variety of operational documents and reports.
Supply Chain & Warehouse Support

• Provide administrative back-up for spare parts order processing.
• Support logistics and warehouse administration activities.
• Assist with shipment documentation and transportation-related paperwork.
• Act as a flexible support resource during peak periods or colleague absences.
International Coordination

• Communicate regularly with customers and colleagues across Europe.
• Support cross-functional collaboration between various departments and countries.

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent through experience.
• Previous experience in an administrative, customer service, or commercial support role.
• Experience with invoicing or billing processes is a strong advantage.
• Strong organisational skills with excellent attention to detail.
• Customer-oriented mindset and effective communication skills.
• Ability to prioritise tasks and manage multiple responsibilities simultaneously.
• Flexible, proactive, and supportive team player.
• Capable of working independently while maintaining strong collaboration with colleagues.
• Good knowledge of Microsoft Office applications.
• Experience with ERP systems is an advantage; SAP knowledge is considered a plus.
• Fluent in Dutch and French
• Knowledge of German is highly desirable
• Good level of English

The organisation operates in the Professional Services industry in Brussels.

Jobomschrijving

As a Legal Assistant your responsibilities are:

• Prepare & format legal documents, letters and presentations to ensure clear and accurate output.
• Manage calendars, arrange meetings and coordinate appointments to support efficient daily planning.
• Organise files and maintain document records so information is easy to find when needed.
• Handle incoming and outgoing correspondence in a timely and professional manner
• Assistance with hotel and travel arrangements, taxis orders, restaurants reservations, preparations of expense reports, occasional assistance with roaming updates, occasional assistance with visa applications
• Billing assistance (formatting, saving, printing and coordination with Billing team), keep track of recorded client invoices
• Support the preparation of reports and documents for ongoing legal and business activities.

A successful Legal Assistant should have:

• Ideally you already have an experience in a similar function within a law firm
• English / French or Dutch
• Strong administrative and secretarial support skills.
• Confidence in managing diaries, meetings and changing priorities.
• Good document organisation and record-management capability.
• Clear written communication skills for professional correspondence.

jobs.occupation: Country Head of IT - Global Manufacturing
jobs.description:
The hiring company is a leading global industrial and manufacturing organization with operations across multiple continents and a strong presence in Thailand. The business operates in a highly technology-driven environment, with significant manufacturing operations and a broad international network.

Jobomschrijving

• Lead the overall IT strategy and operations across Thailand.
• Act as the senior technology partner to country and business leadership.
• Ensure reliable, secure, and effective IT services across the organization.
• Oversee infrastructure, applications, cybersecurity, data, end-user services, and technology operations.
• Drive technology transformation and modernization initiatives aligned with business priorities.
• Establish strong IT governance, standards, policies, and risk management.
• Lead and develop the local IT organization and technology capabilities..
• Manage strategic technology partners, vendors, and service providers.
• Oversee IT budgets, investments, and resource planning.
• Work closely with regional and global technology teams on enterprise initiatives.
• Identify opportunities where technology can improve business performance, efficiency, and scalability.
To apply online please click the 'Apply' button below. For a confidential discussion about this role please contact Gift Petto on  66 2 012 5067.

• 10  years of experience in IT, with significant leadership responsibility
• Experience leading IT within a large, multinational organization
• Strong background across IT operations, infrastructure, applications, cybersecurity, and technology transformation
• Experience managing teams, budgets, vendors, and complex technology environments
• Strong business partnering and stakeholder management capabilities
• Ability to operate effectively across both local and regional/global environments
• Bachelor's degree in IT, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline
Preferred

• Experience in a manufacturing or industrial environment
• Previous country, regional, or enterprise IT leadership experience
• Experience leading technology transformation in a complex multinational organization
• Strong understanding of cybersecurity, governance, and IT risk
• Excellent English communication skills

Our client is an international company active in a highly technical environment, serving professionals across the industrial sector. They are looking for a Customer Service & Technical Support Specialist to join their customer-facing operations team.

Jobomschrijving

As the primary point of contact for customers, you will ensure a smooth process from enquiry to order completion. You will work closely with customers, sales colleagues, and internal departments to provide accurate information, prepare quotations, and coordinate orders.Key Responsibilities

• Manage customer requests and provide high-quality service throughout the sales process.
• Prepare and follow up on quotations based on customer requirements.
• Gather and verify technical and commercial information related to projects and orders.
• Coordinate with sales teams and internal stakeholders to ensure timely processing.
• Maintain accurate information in internal systems.
• Create or review basic technical drawings when required.
• Monitor order data and identify discrepancies, stock issues, or missing information.
• Contribute to continuous improvements in customer satisfaction and operational efficiency.

• Bachelor-level education or equivalent experience.
• Previous experience in Customer Service, Sales Support, Order Management, or After-Sales is required.
• Experience within a technical, engineering, manufacturing, industrial, or construction-related environment is highly desirable.
• Familiarity with technical drawing software such as CAD is considered an advantage.
• Comfortable working with ERP and CRM systems.
• Customer-focused, proactive, and solution-oriented mindset.
• Strong communication skills and ability to work cross-functionally.
• Fluent in Dutch, with a professional level of French and a good command of English.

jobs.occupation: Investor Acquisition Manager - Investment Management Firm
jobs.description:
Our client is an international investment firm specializing in discretionary portfolio management for private and institutional investors. Active across Belgium and Luxembourg, the company benefits from a strong reputation and continued growth throughout European markets.

Jobomschrijving

• Contact and qualify high-net-worth prospects generated through marketing campaigns, and develop your own prospect opportunities
• Develop investor interest and schedule advisory meetings
• Conduct multiple discussions with prospects and guide them through the decision-making process until investment commitment
• Support clients throughout the account opening and funding process
• Achieve commercial targets in terms of outreach, meetings, and new client acquisition
• Develop your expertise in wealth management through a structured training program
• Collaborate closely with portfolio management and client service teams to deliver an outstanding client experience

• Degree in Finance, Economics, Business or equivalent professional experience
• Minimum 5 years of successful sales or business development experience within financial services
• Fluent in Dutch or French, with a professional command of English
• Proven track record in acquiring high-net-worth clients and generating new investment business
• Strong consultative selling skills and confidence discussing investment-related topics
• Entrepreneurial mindset, resilience and excellent relationship-building abilities

jobs.occupation: Office manager / Administrative & Supply Chain Freelancer
jobs.description:
Our client is an industrial company specialized in the manufacturing of technical products. Part of an international group, the organization offers a dynamic, hands-on environment where flexibility, autonomy, and collaboration are highly valued.

Jobomschrijving

As an Office Manager/ Administrative & Supply Chain Freelancer your responsibilities are:

• Act as the main point of contact for customer administrative inquiries.
• Coordinate supplier orders and monitor procurement activities.
• Organize shipments and oversee logistics operations.
• Process and monitor customer and supplier invoices.
• Support accounting administration and cash flow follow-up.
• Manage HR administration and prepare payroll-related information.
• Contribute to the ERP transition from Odoo to SAP and support process adaptation.
• Manage customer orders from receipt through to delivery.
• Client-focused mindset with excellent relationship management skills, ensuring coordination across production capacity and delivery.

A successful Office Manager/ Administrative & Supply Chain Freelancer should have:

• Proven experience as an Office Manager, Administrative Manager, or Administrative Coordinator.
• Experience within an industrial or manufacturing environment.
• Good understanding of sales administration, procurement, and supply chain processes.
• Comfortable managing customer orders, suppliers, and logistics coordination.
• Strong IT skills and experience working with ERP systems.
• Knowledge of Odoo and/or SAP is considered an asset.
• Fluent in French with a good command of English.
• Autonomous, organized, solution-oriented, and able to manage multiple priorities.

Our client is a well-established international organisation based in Brussels, bringing together professionals and stakeholders from across Europe. Operating in a dynamic and multicultural environment, the organisation plays a key role in supporting collaboration, policy development and industry best practices on an international scale.With employees and members from numerous countries, the organisation offers a collaborative workplace where professionalism, continuous improvement and teamwork are highly valued.

Jobomschrijving

• Welcome visitors and act as the main point of contact for employees, guests and external partners.
• Ensure the office remains operational, organised and ready for daily business activities.
• Coordinate meeting rooms, prepare meeting spaces and support internal events and workshops.
• Manage office supplies, catering services, incoming and outgoing mail, and document archiving.
• Liaise with external suppliers and service providers to ensure smooth facility operations.
• Coordinate preventive and corrective maintenance of building systems and office equipment.
• Support workspace optimisation projects, including storage and inventory management.
• Contribute to creating a professional, safe and pleasant working environment for all employees and visitors.

• Secondary education diploma or equivalent experience.
• Initial experience (1 to 3 years) in office coordination, workplace services, hospitality, reception or administrative support.
• Comfortable working with Microsoft Office tools.
• Excellent communication skills in English, combined with a good knowledge of either French or Dutch. Knowledge of both is a strong asset.
• Customer-oriented and proactive mindset with a strong sense of service.
• Organised and detail-oriented, capable of managing multiple priorities simultaneously.
• Reliable, discreet and able to work autonomously while remaining a true team player.
• Available to work on-site on a full-time basis.

Our client is a leading provider of digital solutions that help businesses optimise their operations, improve efficiency and accelerate their growth.To support its continued expansion in Belgium, the company is looking for a Field Sales Representative to strengthen its commercial presence in the Brussels region.

Jobomschrijving

As a Field Sales Representative, you will be responsible for developing new business opportunities and expanding the customer portfolio within your assigned territory.Key responsibilities include:

• Identifying and approaching new B2B prospects across Brussels and surrounding areas
• Managing face-to-face client meetings and building long-term relationships
• Understanding customer challenges and presenting tailored digital solutions
• Managing the sales cycle from prospecting to contract signature
• Working closely with internal teams to ensure a seamless customer experience

A successful Field Sales Representative should have:

• 1 to 5 years of experience in B2B sales, field sales or account management
• A strong commercial mindset and hunter mentality
• Excellent communication and negotiation skills
• Fluency in French or Dutch, with a good command of English
• The ability to work independently and take ownership of a territory
• A valid driving licence (B)

Our client is a leading international organisation operating within a fast-paced global environment. The company is recognised for its commitment to operational excellence, continuous improvement, employee development, sustainability, and high standards in workplace experience and facilities management.

Jobomschrijving

• Lead and manage regional facilities operations across multiple sites
• Supervise facilities personnel, including recruitment, onboarding, performance management, and development
• Establish team priorities, allocate resources, and coordinate daily operational activities
• Drive service delivery excellence through vendor and contractor management
• Build and maintain strong relationships with key internal and external stakeholders
• Monitor facility performance and ensure service level agreements are achieved
• Oversee maintenance programmes, inspections, audits, and emergency preparedness plans
• Ensure compliance with applicable health, safety, environmental, and regulatory requirements
• Develop and implement facilities management policies and operational procedures
• Prepare business cases and presentations for capital investments and improvement initiatives
• Manage operating budgets, financial reporting, forecasting, and cost control activities
• Identify operational risks and implement corrective actions proactively
• Support long-term facilities strategy and asset optimisation initiatives
• Promote a culture of continuous improvement, teamwork, and operational excellence

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience
• Previous experience in Facilities Management, Property Management, Workplace Services, or a related field
• Proven people management experience, including coaching and performance development
• Strong understanding of building operations, maintenance, compliance, and workplace services
• Experience managing operating budgets, financial analysis, and capital projects
• Excellent organisational and problem-solving abilities
• Strong stakeholder engagement and client relationship management skills
• Ability to manage multiple priorities within a fast-moving environment
• Proficient in Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, Word, and Outlook

• Fluent in English, French, and Dutch, both written and spoken
